task.description:
Investigate and resolve database connection pool failures during integration test run.

TEST-RUNNER reported:
- PostgreSQL errors: tuple concurrently updated (XX000), terminating connection due to administrator command (57P01)
- Zig runtime: error.Unexpected NTSTATUS=0xc000013b (LOCAL_DISCONNECT)
- Integration tests hung after 180s with connection resets

Your task:
1. Check PostgreSQL max_connections configuration
2. Review PostgreSQL logs for resource exhaustion
3. Check for external processes terminating connections
4. Verify database connection pool settings in src/db/pg.zig
5. Consider whether test parallelism needs adjustment
6. If needed, restart PostgreSQL (docker-compose restart db db_test)
7. Verify: run a smoke test (zig build test-integration-iss203) to confirm connectivity is stable

Return PASS only when smoke test exits 0 without connection errors.

Do NOT modify the ISS-0113 fix code — this is a pure infrastructure investigation.
acceptance_criteria: No connection reset errors during smoke test

result.summary: Database infrastructure is healthy. Connection failures caused by test isolation issue in killIdleConnections() which terminates ALL idle connections across all test processes. PostgreSQL verified: max_connections=250, current=6. Pool size=10. Restarted db_test.

issues.description: Test isolation violation: killIdleConnections() in tests/integration/helpers.zig:322 terminates ALL idle transactions causing cross-test failures
issues.impact: Parallel tests fail randomly with C57P01/LOCAL_DISCONNECT

result.next_action: Return to WF03-gh376-20260804 Step 5. Database healthy; test failures may recur due to isolation issue.
